d:
Bijepi ke rashtriy adhyaksh nitin navin ke us bayan par, jismen unhonne kaha tha ki 'samajvadi parti ke shasankal men har jile men ek maphiya hota tha', bihar sarkar ke mantri mithilesh tivari ne apni jordar pratikriya di hai aur vipakshi netaon par jamkar nishana sadha hai.
Mantri mithilesh tivari ne akhilesh yadav aur tejasvi yadav ki rajniti par saval uthate hue kaha, "chahe akhilesh yadav hon ya lalu yadav ki parti jiska netritv tejasvi yadav kar rahe hain, kya in logon ko aam janta ki koee chinta hai? inhonne kabhi sadharan janta ke kalyan ke lie rajniti nahin ki."
